Green Clan's residence


Setting

The Green Clan’s home introduces Zak to the Woodsfolk and their distrust of outsiders. Their troubles, including the fate of their elder, become part of the search through Ingos. [1, 2]

The arrow and the Green Clan

The arrow in the Snoop’s body appears to implicate the Woodsfolk. Sver explains that their markings identify a clan, while the governor discovers that the case containing similar arrows has been stolen from his collection. Two lines of inquiry now run alongside each other: the stolen collection and the Woodsfolk’s testimony. To approach Grey Leaf, Zak first returns the Green Clan’s Sacred Flower after rescuing its keeper from the White Clan. Grey Leaf then asks for help with the kidnapped elder Khabburu and his captor. The clan ultimately identifies the murder arrow as a false attribution, even refusing to blame its enemies for it. When the clan moves, Zak receives access to its hidden route and new home. [3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
